text:
AI is more than a better way to search.

Over a drink with NVIDIA’s Chris Alexiuk, @langdock Co-CEO @DadaJudith shared why AI’s biggest impact may be felt in better services, better products, and healthier, more affordable lives.

Watch their full conversation from GTC Berlin: https://t.co/WIi6tl3Hlg
